item.title: Possible Keter Class article Hurricane Omega
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: Other: Keter Class Scenario

Genre (Optional): Other: Apocalypse Scenario

Elevator Pitch: What if there was a Hurricane season so bad that all the named storms were used and they went to the End of the Greek Alphabet. And Hurricane Omega becomes a Keter class Hurricane.

Central Narrative: The story will follow the survivors of this storm thrashed world where the SCP try to use weather manipulating SCPs to stop it but they all fail or make the storm worse.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Not sure on this, part of what I am looking for advice on.

Additional Notes: This is just a rough idea right now. I will sit down and write out the story if there is any real interest in it. I live on the Gulf Coast so the idea of a Hurricane so powerful it could end the world is interesting to me.
